g.desc: {"kind":"workflow","id":"main","title":"A web app takes an order","subtitle":"from the browser to the database and back","description":"A user opens the app, signs in and buys. [The API](#backend.api) answers every request at once; [the receipt](#main/receipt) is sent later.","steps":[{"id":"load","title":"The browser loads the page","description":"[The CDN](#cdn) serves the HTML, scripts and images; no request reaches your servers yet.","layer":0,"items":[{"edge":"(browser -> cdn)[0]"}]},{"id":"sign-in","title":"The user signs in","description":"[The API](#backend.api) checks the password and stores the session in [the cache](#data.cache), so later requests skip the database.","layer":1,"items":[{"edge":"(browser -> backend.api)[0]"},{"edge":"(backend.api -> data.cache)[0]"}]},{"id":"order","title":"The user places an order","description":"[The API](#backend.api) reads [the session](#backend.api->data.cache[1]) back and saves the order in [the database](#data.db).","layer":1,"items":[{"edge":"(browser -> backend.api)[1]"},{"edge":"(backend.api -> data.cache)[1]"},{"edge":"(backend.api -> data.db)[0]"}]},{"id":"receipt","title":"The worker sends the receipt","description":"[The API](#backend.api) only queues the receipt; [the worker](#backend.worker) picks it up and hands it to [the email provider](#mail).","layer":1,"items":[{"edge":"(backend.api -> backend.queue)[0]"},{"edge":"(backend.queue -> backend.worker)[0]"},{"edge":"(backend.worker -> mail)[0]"}]}]}

g.text: A web app takes an order
from the browser to the database and back

g.title: Backend
g.desc: {"kind":"element","path":"backend","label":"Backend","caption":"your servers","description":"Every browser request lands on [the API](#backend.api). From there:\n- the API answers the browser right away\n- work that can wait, like the receipt, goes through [the queue](#backend.queue) to [the worker](#backend.worker)"}

g.title: Data
g.desc: {"kind":"element","path":"data","label":"Data","caption":"what the app remembers","description":"[The database](#data.db) keeps users and orders. [The cache](#data.cache) keeps the reads the API repeats most."}

g.title: sends the receipt
g.desc: {"kind":"lifted","from":"backend","to":"mail","label":"sends the receipt","edges":[{"kind":"edge","edge":"(backend.worker -> mail)[0]","from":"backend.worker","to":"mail","label":"sends the receipt","description":"The email provider delivers the receipt to the user's inbox."}]}

g.desc: {"kind":"lifted","from":"backend","to":"mail","label":"sends the receipt","edges":[{"kind":"edge","edge":"(backend.worker -> mail)[0]","from":"backend.worker","to":"mail","label":"sends the receipt","description":"The email provider delivers the receipt to the user's inbox."}]}
